column1: # Shared fork-layer rename table: NeoForge 1.21.5 -> 1.21.8 (Minecraft 1.21.8; NeoForge 21.8; FML 9). Applied FIRST (nearest
# target) on the 1.21.1 text, then the 1.21.5/1.21.4/1.21.3 tables on whatever it left, so a row here that rewrites
# something those rows also rewrite has to write the 1.21.8 form itself. Measured against neoforge-21.8.54-sources.jar
# on the first layer-fork port (the unattended 1.21.8 loop's residue, which put every one of these in a per-fork overlay).
#!exhaustive  # shared library: most forks use only some of these rows
# ---- FML 9: @EventBusSubscriber has no `bus` any more; the bus follows from the event class (a mod-bus event is
# delivered on the mod bus, anything else on the game bus), so dropping the argument keeps every subscriber where it was.
re:,\s*bus\s*=\s*(?:EventBusSubscriber\.)?Bus\.(?:MOD|GAME)\b
re:\bbus\s*=\s*(?:EventBusSubscriber\.)?Bus\.(?:MOD|GAME)\s*,\s*
re:import net\.neoforged\.fml\.common\.EventBusSubscriber\.Bus;\n
# ---- mixin targets (invisible to javac; tools/audit-mixin-targets.py checks them against the target's sources)
# LevelRenderer.renderLevel(DeltaTracker, boolean, Camera, GameRenderer, LightTexture, Matrix4f, Matrix4f) became
# (GraphicsResourceAllocator, DeltaTracker, boolean, Camera, Matrix4f, Matrix4f, GpuBufferSlice, Vector4f, boolean): the
# GameRenderer and LightTexture are gone, and the fog buffer, the fog colour and a "render the sky" flag arrived.
# This row runs on the 1.21.1 text, before the 1.21.4/1.21.3 rows, so it writes the whole 1.21.8 descriptor itself.

re:LevelRenderer;renderLevel\(Lnet/minecraft/client/DeltaTracker;ZLnet/minecraft/client/Camera;Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/GameRenderer;Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/LightTexture;Lorg/joml/Matrix4f;Lorg/joml/Matrix4f;\)V
# ... and the callback of an @Inject into it (the same eight 1.21.1 parameters, then the CallbackInfo)

re:(@Inject\(method = "renderLevel"[\s\S]{0,300}?private void [\w$]+\()DeltaTracker (\w+), boolean (\w+), Camera (\w+),\s*GameRenderer \w+, LightTexture \w+,\s*Matrix4f (\w+), Matrix4f (\w+), CallbackInfo (\w+)\)
column2: \1com.mojang.blaze3d.resource.GraphicsResourceAllocator mv$allocator, DeltaTracker \2, boolean \3, Camera \4,\n            Matrix4f \5, Matrix4f \6, com.mojang.blaze3d.buffers.GpuBufferSlice mv$fog, org.joml.Vector4f mv$fogColor, boolean mv$sky, CallbackInfo \7)

column1: # Entity.addAdditionalSaveData / readAdditionalSaveData (and LivingEntity's) take a ValueOutput / ValueInput (1.21.6). A handler
# that only PUTS scalars keeps its body (ValueOutput has putInt/putString/putBoolean/...); one that reads needs
# ValueInput's Optional/`...Or` getters and has no contains() -- see the fork's overlay of it for the shape.
re:(@Inject\(method = "addAdditionalSaveData"[\s\S]{0,300}?private void [\w$]+\()CompoundTag (\w+)
re:(@Inject\(method = "readAdditionalSaveData"[\s\S]{0,300}?private void [\w$]+\()CompoundTag (\w+)
# ServerCommonPacketListenerImpl.send(Packet, PacketSendListener) takes a netty ChannelFutureListener (1.21.6)
re:(\bsend\(Lnet/minecraft/network/protocol/Packet;)Lnet/minecraft/network/PacketSendListener;\)V
re:(\bPacket<\?> \w+, )PacketSendListener (\w+)(, CallbackInfo)
# ---- CATALOG V81: the 3-argument playBidirectional / commonBidirectional / configurationBidirectional(type, codec, handler)
# registers only the SERVER handler on NeoForge 21.8 (the 4-argument form takes the client one, @Nullable), and the client then
# refuses to load: "Some clientbound payloads are missing client-side handlers". 1.21.1's 3-argument form served both
# directions, and a handler for a bidirectional payload already branches on ctx.flow(), so passing the SAME handler twice
# restores that exactly. The rows fire only on the 3-argument shape (a 4-argument call has a second top-level comma before its
# closing paren, which the handler group cannot cross). Two rows: a method reference (the usual shape), and an EXPRESSION lambda
# (the text is repeated; a block lambda is not handled -- write that one by hand, or hoist it to a method).
# PacketDistributor.sendToServer moved to the client-only ClientPacketDistributor (NeoForge 21.6+); written fully qualified (a row cannot add an import).
re:\bPacketDistributor\.sendToServer\(
#!strict
